comment: Executor gateway registration for the Herdr tools MCP server (N3.4 artifact, registered live at the N5.3 cutover — see deploy/executor/README). Keys are the executor tool paths to call. `command` pins the real Node binary, not the Volta shim (~/.volta/bin/node): under the executor daemon spawn the shim resolves a different Node ABI and the server refuses to load native addons (re2.node) — discovered at activation and fixed in the live registration.
